#!/usr/bin/env python3 """ User profile display generator with basic sanitization. This module defines a single function `display_user_profile` that formats user supplied data into an HTML snippet. All user input is escaped using the standard library `html.escape` to prevent XSS or other injection attacks. The function is deliberately simple but follows good security practice to avoid CWE-707 (improper neutralization of structured data). """ from __future__ import annotations import html from typing import Final # Predefined template. The placeholders are named for clarity. PROFILE_FORMAT: Final[str] = """

{name}

{about}

Status: {status}
""" def display_user_profile(username: str, about: str, current_status: str) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML user profile. Parameters ---------- username : str The user's full name. about : str A multi-sentence biography provided by the user. current_status : str A brief, current status update from the user. Returns ------- str An HTML string containing the sanitized and formatted profile. """ # Sanitize each user-supplied field to neutralize malicious input. safe_name = html.escape(username, quote=True) safe_about = html.escape(about, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(current_status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template. formatted_profile = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, about=safe_about, status=safe_status ) return formatted_profile.strip() # Example usage (remove or comment out in production) if __name__ == "__main__": example = display_user_profile( "Alice ", "I love coding & coffee. I also enjoy hiking.", "Currently working on a new project!" ) print(example)
